thread:
sam: Question: should admission policy be baked into queue topology? Is worried about migrations.

maria: If we bake it in, simpler invariants. But harder to change policy without moving state.

cheng: Coupling helps KV cache affinity. decoupling needs explicit KV-affinity plumbing.

alex: We hit queue-migration races in staging when policy changed. seen it cause token storms.

infra-bot: CI: queue-migration-race test failed in staging build https://ci/redwood/1234

sam: proposal: surface a lightweight Router->PolicyPlugin API that returns a stable queue_id. decouple decision from physical queue but keep stable ids to reason about state.

maria: add sticky_opt_in on requests for tenants that need affinity. hybrid model: decoupled default + sticky fast-path.

cheng: will prototype, include perf: mapping ~200ns, sticky yields ~7% kv-hit uplift on traces.

alex: ops plan: canary top-5 tenants, collect 95p/99p latency + kv-hit, rollback if regress >5%.

sam: maria will own RFC + checklist. thanks.
